name: fn0_predictions
about: Milestone FN step 0 (docs/dev/v1-flash-next.md section 8, N0-N4): predictions written before any measurement; point estimates with a band. tok/s unless stated; contexts 1K / 4K / 32K; batch 1, 256 output tokens, greedy, ignore-EOS. Strata rows per D11: no-approx = STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=0 --kv fp16 --ple-io ram, calibrated; defaults = setup's command for the card (tail skip on, int8 KV above 8K, PLE O_DIRECT); drafting off = no --mtp, --suffix-draft 0; MTP matched = --spec 4 --spec-min-p 0 --suffix-draft 0, STRATA_MTP_FULL_HEAD=1.

n0.eos_ids_ignore: Strata's --eos-ids accepts an id outside the vocabulary (999999), so every request ends at its length: no EOS pre-screening needed
n0.calibrate: tools/calibrate.py keeps the defaults on both cards except possibly --pcie-frac (one setting moves at most); about 30 min per card

freetoken.band: x0.5-1.5; may not load the IQ1_M / Q2_0 experts

n1.strata_expert_cache: auto picks about 6.5-8 GB of experts on the 16 GB card (20-23%), 20-24 GB on the 32 GB card (40-48%); prefill chunk auto = 8192 on both
n1.strata_decode_hit_rate: 75-90% on the RTX 5080, 88-95% on the RTX 5090

row_gather_zero_copy.note: 16 rows x 90 B per token from a mapped pinned host table over PCIe; about 10 GB/s of useful bytes at 4,096 tokens; RTX 5090 within 20% of the 5080

odirect_4k_reads.note: random 4 KiB O_DIRECT reads of the PLE shard on the desktop's NVMe, Linux AIO; a prefill token needs at most 16 pages, so queue depth 32-64 covers >= 15K tok/s of read-ahead

n3.method: Holon decode per token = (dense bytes + hit bytes) / 816 GB/s (RTX 5080; 1,500 GB/s RTX 5090) + miss bytes / 44 GB/s (F5a) + per-layer overhead (X's capped Qwen3-30B-A3B row: 8.39 ms per token at 170 MB of misses gives 2.1 ms per 48 layers; FN's denser layers: 2.5-3 ms); hit rate from a routing trace with lfu at Holon's cache. Prefill per step = max(PCIe streaming of non-resident and lent experts, expert GEMMs + dense trunk), the expert GEMMs scaled from X's measured mmq rows.

holon_prefill_vs_strata.band: 0.8-1.2 (the MoE prefill track's D1-D5 decide it; R2)

n3.rows_predicted_below_0_9: none at the central estimate; prefill rows at risk

oracle_32k.note: one 32K v1-long prompt through the streamed fp32 HF driver (transformers 5.19.0) on the CPU, one layer resident
oracle_32k.dominant_cost: dequantizing a layer's 512 experts to fp32 (10 GB per layer) in gguf-py
